proposal: The Mandate recommends that EPA reconsider the regulatory goal of restoring natural visibility by 2064, since the statute sets no such date, and consider a longer and less disruptive timeline. It also recommends revising the regional haze rules so that later planning periods cannot be used to force the shutdown of particular facilities.

status_summary: On 2025-10-02 EPA published an advance notice of proposed rulemaking seeking comment on how to revise the Regional Haze Rule to streamline states' visibility improvement obligations. On 2026-01-06 EPA published a final rule, effective 2026-03-09, that moves the due date for third-planning-period state plans from 2028-07-31 to 2031-07-31; the rule describes the advance notice as the first step, says EPA has not yet proposed specific program changes, and says EPA intends to revise the rule on a different timeline. No proposed rule revising the Regional Haze Rule itself was found in the Federal Register through 2026-10-13. EPA has also been reconsidering individual state plan actions, for example a 2026-09-09 proposal to repeal its 2024-12-02 partial disapproval of North Dakota's second-period plan and approve the disapproved parts.

timeline.event: EPA published an advance notice of proposed rulemaking on revising the Regional Haze Rule state plan requirements.
EPA published a final rule extending the third-implementation-period state plan due date from 2028-07-31 to 2031-07-31 (effective 2026-03-09).
EPA proposed to repeal its 2024-12-02 partial approval and partial disapproval of North Dakota's second-period regional haze plan and to approve the previously disapproved parts.

title: Revise the Regional Haze Rule and relax the 2064 natural visibility goal
uncertainties: Federal Register searches through 2026-10-13 found no proposed national revision of the Regional Haze Rule after the 2025 advance notice. The documents read do not mention the 2064 date; the 2026 extension rule says only that the statute sets no end date for reaching the national goal. Whether EPA will change the 2064 glide path is not stated.
